chore: adaptations for nightly-2026-08-18 nightly#288

Please review this PR. At the next toolchain release this diff will land in master.
Note: this PR includes Paul's adaptation notes added after lean#14624.
Thanks a lot @Paul Reichert for the detailed explanations in the adaptation notes!

Sorry to do a massive ping here, but I think there might be some value in getting the attention of relevant authors on to these carefully prepared adaptation notes, in the hope we can get things fixed while Paul still has this work fresh in his mind.
